description:
The "second" season of Dongitsune: a series of animated commercials for Nissin’s line of Donbei Kitsune Udon instant noodles.

Episodes:
#1) どんぎつねシーズン2 秋祭 篇 / Dongitsune Season 2: Akimatsuri-hen [September 28, 2022].
#2) どんぎつねシーズン2 耳そこなんですか？ 篇 / Dongitsune Season 2: Mimi Soko Nandesu ka?-hen [October 31, 2022].
#3) 最強のどんぎつね現るッッ / Saikyou no Dongitsune Arawaru [November 21, 2022].
#4) 最強年越し 篇 / Saikyou Toshikoshi-hen [December 1, 2022].
#5) 正直すぎる尻尾 篇 / Shoujiki Sugiru Shippo-hen [February 15, 2023].
#6) カップよりうまい 篇 / Cup Yori Umai-hen [March 30, 2023].
#7) どん兵衛プロ出た 篇 / Donbei PRO Deta-hen [September 7, 2023].
#8) 耳は正直 2023 篇 / Mimi wa Shoujiki 2023-hen [November 15, 2023].
#9) 年越しアイドル 篇 / Toshikoshi Idol-hen [December 9, 2023].
#10) 片翼のどんぎつね 篇 / Henyoku no Dongitsune-hen [February 28, 2024].

Note: The “first” season was a series of live-action commercials starring Riho Yoshioka and Gen Hoshino.
